questions.question: God told Ezekiel not to mourn his wife's death, as a sign to Israel. When the people did the same, what would they know?

answers.text: That He is the Lord GOD
That Ezekiel is a true priest

questions.question: After the prophet Ezekiel spoke to the people one morning, who in his family died that evening?
God told Ezekiel He would desecrate the desire of Israel's eyes, the pride of their power. What was it?
God told Ezekiel that when a man who escaped brought him news, what would change for Ezekiel?

answers.text: He would speak and no longer be mute
He would be set free from exile
He would see Jerusalem with his eyes
